這裡有什麼？　當你打出這個角色以及每當他探險時，你可以將一張物品卡從你的棄牌堆移回手牌。
浮誇　你每有一個物品在場，這個角色就獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Develop Your Brain
en:
Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your
hand and the other on the bottom of the deck.
zh: 查看你牌庫頂 2 張卡。將一張加入手牌，另一張放到牌庫底。

name: If It's Not Baroque
en: Return an item card from your discard to your hand.
zh: 將一張物品卡從你的棄牌堆移回手牌。

name: Let It Go
en:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Put chosen character into their player's inkwell facedown and
exerted.
zh:
（費用 5 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將指定角色牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: One Jump Ahead
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and
exerted.
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Work Together
en:
Chosen character gains Support this turn. (Whenever
they quest, you may add their ¤ to another chosen
character's ¤ this turn.)
zh: 指定角色本回合獲得支援。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Coconut Basket
en:
CONSIDER THE COCONUT Whenever you play a character,
you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.
zh: 想想椰子　每當你打出一個角色時，你可以從指定角色身上移除至多 2 點傷害。

name: Eye of the Fates
en:
SEE THE FUTURE ⟳ — Chosen character gets +1 ◊
this turn.
zh: 看見未來　⟳ — 指定角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Fishbone Quill
en:
GO AHEAD AND SIGN ⟳ — Put any card from your
hand into your inkwell facedown.
zh: 簽下去吧　⟳ — 將任何一張手牌牌面朝下放入你的墨水池。

name: Magic Golden Flower
en:
HEALING POLLEN Banish this item — Remove up to 3
damage from chosen character.
zh: 治療花粉　消滅這個物品 — 從指定角色身上移除至多 3 點傷害。

name: Scepter of Arendelle
en:
COMMAND ⟳ — Chosen character gains Support
this turn. (Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤
to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
zh: 命令　⟳ — 指定角色本回合獲得支援。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Beast - Hardheaded
en:
BREAK When you play this character, you may
banish chosen item.
zh: 破壞　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定的物品。

name: Captain Hook - Captain of the Jolly Roger
en:
DOUBLE THE POWDER! When you play this
character, you may return an action card named
Fire the Cannons! from your discard to your hand.
zh: 雙倍火藥！　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一張名為 Fire the Cannons! 的行動卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Captain Hook - Forceful Duelist
en:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
zh: 挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Captain Hook - Thinking a Happy Thought
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Captain Hook.)
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character
gets +3 ¤.)
STOLEN DUST Characters with cost 3 or less can't
challenge this character.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Captain Hook 的角色上。）
挑戰者 +3（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +3 ¤。）
偷來的精靈粉　費用 3 或以下的角色不能挑戰這個角色。

name: Donald Duck - Musketeer
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
STAY ALERT! During your turn, your Musketeer
characters gain Evasive. (They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
保持警覺！　在你的回合中，你的火槍手角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Gantu - Galactic Federation Captain
en:
UNDER ARREST Characters with cost 2 or less
can't challenge your characters.
zh: 逮捕　費用 2 或以下的角色不能挑戰你的角色。

name: Hans - Thirteenth in Line
en:
STAGE A LITTLE ACCIDENT Whenever this
character quests, you may deal 1 damage to
chosen character.
zh: 製造小意外　每當這個角色探險時，你可以對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Hercules - True Hero
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
zh: 護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）

name: Mickey Mouse - Musketeer
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
ALL FOR ONE Your other Musketeer characters
get +1 ¤.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
人人為我　你其他的火槍手角色獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Prince Eric - Dashing and Brave
en:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
zh: 挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Simba - Future King
en:
GUESS WHAT? When you play this character, you
may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
zh: 猜怎麼著？　當你打出這個角色時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Simba - Returned King
en:
Challenger +4 (While challenging, this character gets
+4 ¤.)
POUNCE During your turn, this character gains
Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
zh:
挑戰者 +4（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +4 ¤。）
猛撲　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Simba - Rightful Heir
en:
I KNOW WHAT I HAVE TO DO During your
turn, whenever this character banishes another
character in a challenge, you gain 1 lore.
zh: 我知道我該做什麼　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Starkey - Hook's Henchman
en:
AYE AYE, CAPTAIN While you have a Captain
character in play, this character gets +1 ◊.
zh: 是，是，船長　當你有一個船長角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Te Kā - Heartless
en:
SEEK THE HEART During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, you gain 2 lore.
zh: 尋找真心　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Tinker Bell - Giant Fairy
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Tinker Bell.)
ROCK THE BOAT When you play this character, deal 1
damage to each opposing character.
PUNY PIRATE! During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, you may deal 2
damage to chosen opposing character.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Tinker Bell 的角色上。）
搖晃船隻　當你打出這個角色時，對每個對方角色造成 1 點傷害。
渺小的海盜！　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你可以對指定的對方角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Tinker Bell - Tiny Tactician
en:
BATTLE PLANS ⟳ — Draw a card, then choose
and discard a card.
zh: 作戰計畫　⟳ — 抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: A Whole New World
en:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each player discards their hand and draws 7 cards.
zh:
（費用 5 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
每位玩家棄掉其手牌並抽 7 張牌。

name: Break
en: Banish chosen item.
zh: 消滅指定的物品。

name: Fire the Cannons!
en: Deal 2 damage to chosen character.
zh: 對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Grab Your Sword
en:
(A character with cost 5 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for
free.)
Deal 2 damage to each opposing character.
zh:
（費用 5 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
對每個對方角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Ransack
en: Draw 2 cards, then choose and discard 2 cards.
zh: 抽兩張牌，然後選擇並棄掉 2 張卡。

name: Smash
en: Deal 3 damage to chosen character.
zh: 對指定角色造成 3 點傷害。

name: Beast's Mirror
en:
SHOW ME ⟳, 3 ⬡ — If you have no cards in your
hand, draw a card.
zh: 給我看　⟳，3 ⬡ — 若你手上沒有卡，抽一張牌。

name: Frying Pan
en:
CLANG! Banish this item — Chosen character can't
challenge during their next turn.
zh: 鏘！　消滅這個物品 — 指定角色在其下個回合不能挑戰。

name: Musketeer Tabard
en:
ALL FOR ONE AND ONE FOR ALL Whenever one of
your characters with Bodyguard is banished, you may
draw a card.
zh: 人人為我，我為人人　每當你一個具護衛的角色被消滅時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Plasma Blaster
en:
QUICK SHOT ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Deal 1 damage to chosen
character.
zh: 快速射擊　⟳，2 ⬡ — 對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Hades - King of Olympus
en:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Hades.)
SINISTER PLOT This character gets +1 ◊ for each
other Villain character you have in play.
zh:
變身 6（你可以支付 6 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Hades 的角色上。）
邪惡陰謀　你每有一個其他反派角色在場，這個角色就獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Stitch - Carefree Surfer
en:
OHANA When you play this character, if you
have 2 or more other characters in play, you may
draw 2 cards.
zh: 歐哈納　當你打出這個角色時，若你另有 2 個或以上的角色在場，你可以抽兩張牌。

name: Elsa - Spirit of Winter
en:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Elsa.)
DEEP FREEZE When you play this character, exert up
to 2 chosen characters. They can't ready at the start of
their next turn.
zh:
變身 6（你可以支付 6 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Elsa 的角色上。）
深度冰凍　當你打出這個角色時，橫置至多 2 個指定角色。他們在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: Mickey Mouse - Wayward Sorcerer
en:
ANIMATE BROOM You pay 1 ⬡ less to play Broom
characters.
CEASELESS WORKER Whenever one of your Broom
characters is banished in a challenge, you may return
that card to your hand.
zh:
喚醒掃帚　你打出掃帚角色時少支付 1 ⬡。
不停歇的工人　每當你一個掃帚角色在挑戰中被消滅時，你可以將該卡移回你的手牌。

name: Genie - On the Job
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
DISAPPEAR When you play this character, you may
return chosen character to their player's hand.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
消失　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將指定角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Mickey Mouse - Artful Rogue
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Mickey Mouse.)
MISDIRECTION Whenever you play an action, chosen
opposing character can't quest during their next turn.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Mickey Mouse 的角色上。）
聲東擊西　每當你打出一個行動時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合不能探險。

name: Aladdin - Heroic Outlaw
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Aladdin.)
DARING EXPLOIT During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, you gain 2 lore and
each opponent loses 2 lore.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Aladdin 的角色上。）
大膽壯舉　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你獲得 2 點傳說值，每位對手失去 2 點傳說值。

name: Maui - Hero to All
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
zh:
突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）

name: Aurora - Dreaming Guardian
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Aurora.)
PROTECTIVE EMBRACE Your other characters gain Ward.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Aurora 的角色上。）
守護的擁抱　你其他的角色獲得守護。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Belle - Strange but Special
en:
READ A BOOK During your turn, you may ink an additional
card.
MY FAVORITE PART! While you have 10 or more cards in
your inkwell, this character gets +4 ◊.
zh:
讀本書　在你的回合中，你可以額外將一張卡放入墨水池。
我最愛的部分！　當你墨水池中有 10 張或以上的卡時，這個角色獲得 +4 ◊。

name: Simba - Returned King
en:
Challenger +4 (When challenging, this character gets
+4 ¤.)
POUNCE During your turn, this character gains Evasive.
(They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
zh:
挑戰者 +4（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +4 ¤。）
猛撲　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Tinker Bell - Giant Fairy
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Tinker Bell.)
ROCK THE BOAT When you play this character, deal 1
damage to each opposing character.
PUNY PIRATE! During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, you may deal 2
damage to chosen opposing character.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Tinker Bell 的角色上。）
搖晃船隻　當你打出這個角色時，對每個對方角色造成 1 點傷害。
渺小的海盜！　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你可以對指定的對方角色造成 2 點傷害。
